spans.s: A Buddhist; a follower of Sugata or Buddha; (the Buddhists are divided into four great schools; माध्यमिक, सौत्रान्तिक, योगाचार & वैभासिक); सौगतजरत्परिव्राजिकायास्तु कामन्दक्याः प्रथमां भूमिकां भाव एवाधीते [[

A Buddhist mendicant. 
__2 An atheist, a heretic, an unbeliever. 
-कम् Unbelief, heresy, atheism, scepticism.
